T-Rex Run 3D (dino3d)
=====================

Title:      T-Rex Run 3D
Author:     Abraham Tugalov (Priler), (C) 2020
            Uses three.js (MIT), vox.js by daishihmr (MIT), howler.js (MIT), three-nebula (MIT) and
            visibly.js by Addy Osmani (MIT); models made in MagicaVoxel.
Source:     https://github.com/Priler/dino3d  (branch master; the repository root is the built game)
Upstream:   commit 5b0a0903d0f5c1cd7c4a7dd325d06b175a0b3d3b, dated 2026-07-09
License:    GNU General Public License v3.0 (see LICENSE in this folder, copied verbatim)

This copy is hosted at https://kaleerson.com/edu/3d/dino3d/ and embedded by https://kaleerson.com/edu/dino3d/
so it works on school networks. It makes requests only to its own origin. The modified source is this folder;
the changes are listed below as the GPL asks.

Entry page: low.html (the author's recommended version, no shadows / antialiasing, lighter on school laptops).
index.html is the same game with the "high" quality config and is shipped too.

Changes made to the upstream files
----------------------------------
1. js/config-high.js and js/config-low.js: "base_path" changed from "/dino3d/" to "./" so sounds, voxel models and
   textures load relative to the page instead of from the site root.
2. libs/nebula/three-nebula.js: removed the trailing "//# sourceMappingURL=three-nebula.js.map" comment (the map
   file is not shipped).
No other file was modified. The interface text (a parody of Chrome's Russian "no internet" page) is unchanged.

Files from the repository that were NOT copied (not needed at runtime)
----------------------------------------------------------------------
- package.json, package-lock.json, gulpfile.js, .github/, .gitignore, README.md
- js/build.js and js/src/ (unminified sources of js/build.min.js, which is what the pages load)
- css/style.css and css/style.scss (sources of css/style.min.css)
- libs/: everything the two pages do not load: dat.gui/, stats/, howler/howler.js, howler.core.min.js,
  howler.spatial.min.js, vox/vox.js, three/three.js, three/three.module.js, three/loaders/GLTFLoader.js,
  three/math/, and every postprocessing pass and shader except EffectComposer, RenderPass, ShaderPass, SAOPass,
  CopyShader, ConvolutionShader, SAOShader, DepthLimitedBlurShader and UnpackDepthRGBAShader
- sound/: only the five files build.min.js plays are shipped (Jump24.wav, Pickup_Coin103.wav, Powerup33.wav,
  Randomize62.wav, ingame/Reloaded Games - Music.ogg); the unreferenced .wav/.mp3 files were left out
- media/bg.jpg and media/_repeat.png, textures/ground_face.jpg and textures/ground_top.psd
- objects/_cactus.vox, objects/ground.vox and objects/t-rex/_old/ (not loaded by build.min.js)

Notes
-----
- Keyboard only: Space or Arrow Up jumps (and starts a game), Arrow Down or Ctrl ducks. There are no touch
  handlers in build.min.js apart from the click on the start / restart buttons.
- High scores are kept in the browser's localStorage; nothing is sent anywhere.

- kaleerson.com: translated the six Russian UI strings in index.html and low.html to English (GAME OVER, Start game, and the parody "No internet" screen). No other change.
